snippet.title: Disco Simulator| PS5 Release Trailer
snippet.description:
🎉 Available January 29th, 2026 on PlayStation 5 👉 https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10011821

Build the ultimate nightlife empire in Disco Simulator 🕺 Start from nothing, design your club, hire staff, and book live artists.

Keep guests happy, handle chaos behind the scenes, and grow your reputation. Upgrade lights, sound, decor, and turn your venue into the hottest club in town. Every night is a new challenge - make it legendary.

#DiscoSimulator #PlayStation5 #PS5Pro #SimulationGame #TycoonGame #IndieGame
